description:
We are conducting a confidential search for an experienced and dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on resident care and facility success.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Join a team committed to delivering high-quality care and operational excellence.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finances, and staff effectively
